theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_tangent_point_representation
theorems.statement: FirstRectifiabilityTheorem → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), (∀ᵐ x ∂C.weight, ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane C x T θ) → ∃ (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsVarifoldOf C M θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane C x T (θ x)) ∧ ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → C.measure A = ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane C x T (θ x) ∧ (x, T) ∈ A}, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
